title: 秋華賞の後に・この気持ちを歌う

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess put all the strength she had into the race, and the result reflected her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer, I'm off to perform Brilliant Phantasia.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If you fall asleep during my performance, I'll clobber you over the head, so pay close attention, all right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Very good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess sings Brilliant Phantasia in a loud, resounding voice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the audience responds with sheer exhilaration.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Thank you so much for coming to see my performance tonight!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Thank you! This was the best!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Well, there's something else that I want to tell you all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: For… For my next goal…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I intend to win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, like a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was young, I always strove to become a princess! And this race is the stage where that dream will finally come true!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So I hope to have your continued support! Will you celebrate with me when I claim first place?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Boy, I'm really looking forward to this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup. Sweep's going to enter too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I heard it on that TV program! A fierce battle between those two will be a must-watch spectacle!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: …She's so selfish. Why's she gotta act like she's the only one on stage?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Not everyone here's rooting for her. I've got my own heroine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm going to become my ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's why I hope you'll accompany me along the path that I carve out!
